answer: An copycat hence has to keep every alias continuously active for 46 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The nectar counter is kept in relic and cipher makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 46 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 5000 identities would post 4263 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
